name: Methyldiethanolamine
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database
source.reference: Kooijman and Taylor, ChemSep v8.3, chemsep1.xml (2021), via https://github.com/DanWBR/dwsim (DWSIM.Thermodynamics/Assets/Databases)
source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 119.1622 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 252.15-675.00 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; ChemSep, as proposal 0008 sets for the components that are not CoolProp fluids (checked against the NIST WebBook where it has data: vapour pressure)
source.measuredCheck: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/python/check_measured.py): 185 measured values from 31 articles, 283.1-423.1 K; median deviation of the articles 0.68 % (within the 1 % tolerance of the engineering report); largest single deviation -2.75 % at 423.1 K (Jayarathna 2012, doi:10.1021/je300530z); docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md
